map.每页平均时长 = 总时长 × 60 ÷ 页数；每要点可用时间 = 每页时长 ÷: Average time per slide = total time × 60 ÷ slides; time per bullet = slide time ÷ bullets; total deliverable words = total time (min) × rate (words/min); suggested per-slide body cap = slide time ÷ 60 × rate × 0.6 (whitespace factor). Font conversion: glyph height (mm) ≈ size (pt) × 0.3528, max viewing distance ≈ height ÷ 5 (m), equivalent pixels = size × 96 ÷ 72. Per-slide time is weighted by cover 0.5, body 1.0, ending 0.7 then normalised; per-slide animation cap = min(slide time × 15%, bullets × 0.6 + 0.5).
